values.note: Reservations required (reservepohickbay.com / ReserveAmerica, or 866-881-0809), paid in full; none for the same day after 8 PM. Minimums by site type (2026 rules): electric-only sites 2 nights April 1 - October 31 (one night allowed November-March); water/electric sites 2 nights all year; full hookup 7 nights when booked more than 60 days out, otherwise 3 nights April-October and 2 nights November-March; every site 3 nights on holiday weekends, with no Saturday or Sunday arrivals or departures when the holiday is a Monday. At most 14 days in 45 in peak season (28 in 45 off-peak on full hookup and water/electric sites). Cancel 14+ days out for a refund less $10; inside 13 days lose one night (two on holiday weekends); no refund or change inside 48 hours.
